reviews.rationale: Selected-source sequential comparison of the Q3 packet against the stored Q2 baseline shows higher GAAP diluted EPS and higher GAAP noninterest income, with lower credit loss provision and lower net chargeoffs, while the FTE net interest margin was essentially flat and FTE net interest income rose only modestly. The signed bridge shows the FTE net interest income increase is fully accounted for by higher interest income and a larger taxable-equivalent adjustment, partly offset by higher interest expense; that is an accounting identity, not an economic driver. Noninterest expense also rose, so the expense base did not shrink. The thesis remains active at unchanged conviction because the packet is a selected-row extract with no year-over-year comparison, no guidance, no non-GAAP EPS reconciliation, no balance-sheet or capital detail, and no disclosure of the drivers behind the fee and provision movements. No valuation or trading conclusion is established.
